logic.bm: Per FY2025 AR p.15-17: 变压器系列 — cast-resin and VPI dry-type transformers (standard and special: wind step-up up to 72.5kV, PV, SFC for pumped storage up to 50,000kVA, rail, data centre), dry-type reactors, amorphous-alloy (dry & liquid) transformers, liquid-immersed power/distribution/offshore-wind transformers; 成套系列 — MV/LV switchgear, box/prefabricated substations, AIDC modular power; 储能系列 — PCS & storage systems; digital-factory solutions; industrial robots. Annual-only product revenue (AR 分产品 tables): 变压器系列 FY2023 4,092.58m, FY2024 4,027.55m; from FY2025 the AR groups 变压器系列+成套系列 as 电气设备系列 = 6,273.27m (FY2024 recast 5,992.89m), 储能系列 620.77m. Customers include Vestas, GE, Siemens Gamesa, Goldwind (wind transformers).
logic.recognition: 제품 출하·고객 검수 또는 프로젝트 진행률의 회사 공시 기준을 대사. 수주액·수주잔고·수출통계는 매출과 별도.
logic.bridge: 이미 인식한 누적 매출 + 납기별 기초 수주잔고 전환 + 당기 수주 중 인도 가능한 물량. 생산능력·취소·검수·환율을 별도 가정.

body.name: Jinpan Technology 金盘科技

reasons: 나우캐스트 앙상블 등급 F — 수치 공개 보류(A·B 만 공개)

profile.end_markets: Wind (onshore/offshore turbines), PV, energy storage, data centres (AIDC), rail, industrial/infrastructure, grid. FY2025 export sales 2,298m = 31.78% of main-business revenue; export backlog 3,491m = 48.44% of 7,207m backlog (FY2025 AR p.39). 2026H1: new orders 7,493m (+69.31%), of which overseas 4,190m (55.92%), data-centre 3,869m (2026 H1 report p.12).

plants.city: Haikou, Hainan (HQ; 海南金盘电气, 海南金盘科技数字化工厂)
Wuhan, Hubei (武汉金盘智能科技, 武汉金拓电气)
Yangzhou, Jiangsu (金盘(扬州)新能源装备制造) / Tongxiang, Zhejiang (浙江金盘实业) / Shaoyang, Hunan (金盘智能科技(湖南)新材料)
Mexico base (墨西哥基地 — expansion completed 2024 per FY2024 AR p.16)
USA (JST Power Equipment, Inc., 80% — R&D, production, sales; ex-Jinpan International (USA)); US transformer plant under preparation (FY2024 AR p.16)
Poland (JST Power Equipment Sp. z o.o., 80%, acquired — first unit off the line 2024)
Malaysia (JST Energy Group Malaysia 85% / JST Smart Technology Malaysia 100%; plant in production 2025)
